headline: A Citi banker says governments around the world will turn to bonds in currencies other than the dollar because AI is draining market liquidity.
score_reason: Headline only (Reuters blocked, no other outlet found); lowered 1 as unverified.
importance_line: If true, governments would raise money outside the dollar market, but the banker, the reasons and the scale are unread, so the claim is one banker's forecast.
summary: Reuters reports, citing a Citi banker, that governments worldwide are expected to turn to non-dollar bonds amid an AI-driven liquidity crunch.
notes: Reuters page returned HTTP 401; TradingView's copy of the Reuters item returned no text; Google News showed no other outlet. Headline only.
